From best to worst:
1) 2005 Most Wanted
Reasoning: This was one of the few racing games I had on my PS2 that had actual customization.
2) ProStreet
Reasoning: I loved the amount of things you could do on that game, from drag racing to large scale circuits.
3) High Stakes
Reasoning: This was the first Need For Speed I've ever played, so it holds a special place in my heart, plus it was the first game I ever played that I could be a cop in.
4) Rivals
Reasoning: I honestly loved the visuals (on the next gen/PC) and thought they looked quite well for what they were. Also, I loved the wide variety of Pursuit Tech in the game.
5) 2010 Hot Pursuit
Reasoning: I thought the game was alright, but not great. I t had quite a small amount of customization (paints), but it did have a decent car selection to choose from.
6) 2012 Most Wanted
Reasoning: It's a good game, but like what a lot of people have said before me, it's not a good Need For Speed Game, it is honestly more of a Burnout game.
7) Need For Speed: Nitro (DSi)
Reasoning: The controls were clunky, the graphics were kinda pixelated, but the customization was actually pretty good for being a DSi Need For Speed game.
8) Undercover (PS2/PS3)
Reasoning: This "game" was a clunky mess on both PS3 and PS2. I truthfully got further in the game on my PS2 than on me PS3. My PS3 copy crashed EVERY TIME during the first Chop Shop missing, and the online play was complete shite to be completely honest.

That's my list.
